topic: Mihawk explained how Supreme King Haki works during the timeskip and Zoro dismissed it as a riddle; chapter 1194 pays it off
title: Mihawk Gave Zoro His Haki Secret As A Riddle
description: Zoro called Mihawk's Supreme King Haki lesson a riddle, and chapter 1194 proves it was a setup. Here is the detail about the dinner table line that most fans forgot.
comment: Was Mihawk really teaching Zoro Supreme King Haki, or did Zoro figure it out alone? Pick one.

lines.text: Mihawk told Zoro how Supreme King Haki works, and Zoro thought it was a riddle.

shot.search: Mihawk Zoro Supreme King Haki riddle
shot.fallback: hawk eyed master speaking to a skeptical swordsman

lines.text: First lesson: coat your swords in Haki, and no drinking until you can.

shot.fallback: master and student training in a gothic castle

lines.text: Second lesson: Supreme King Haki itself, which Zoro wrote off as nonsense.

shot.search: Zoro doubts Mihawk Supreme King Haki

lines.text: Third, at the dinner table: every user of it shares a strong sense of self.

shot.fallback: three people eating in a gothic dining hall

lines.text: Now jump to chapter 1194. Shepherd Sommers says Zoro has the Haki but can't control it.

shot.search: Sommers Zoro Supreme King Haki chapter 1194

lines.text: Zoro recalls Mihawk, adds Gaban's advice, and sends Haki through all three swords.

shot.search: Zoro three swords Haki black lightning
shot.fallback: swordsman with three glowing black swords

lines.text: Nobody connects this: the dinner line wasn't about power. It was about who Zoro had to become.

shot.fallback: swordsman closing his eyes in thought

lines.text: Maybe he was rambling? Mihawk knows the steps to awaken it, chapter 1194.

shot.fallback: hawk eyed swordsman holding a black blade

lines.text: So I think Mihawk didn't teach Zoro how to beat Haki. He taught him the self he needed to hold it.
Zoro wasn't the only one handed a riddle during the timeskip, though.

shot.search: Straw Hats timeskip training Sanji Luffy
shot.fallback: pirates training apart on different islands

lines.text: Which only makes sense if Mihawk told Zoro how Supreme King Haki works...

self_check.hook: Line 1 opens with Mihawk and Zoro and a hidden-detail claim.
